purpose: Fixture-specific, read-only inspection of native Microsoft Word equations, automatic table of contents, multilevel numbering, bookmarks, and page-reference fields across DOCX, DOTX, DOC, and RTF derivatives.

provenance.authoring_method: Computer Use / native Microsoft Word UI
provenance.source: Synthetic content entered and formatted in a native Word document; native Word Save As produced the DOTX, DOC, and RTF derivatives. The DOCX was saved under a native filename and then renamed after close without changing its bytes.

inline.observed_native_ui: Inline equation visibly rendered as x^2 + 1/2 + square root of 9 after Word LaTeX input and Convert.

display.observed_native_ui: Separate display equation visibly rendered as sum k=1..4 k = 10.

table_of_contents.observed_native_ui: Automatic Classic table of contents remained visible after native close and reopen.

numbering.observed_native_ui: Cross-reference dialog and native Word reopen showed hierarchical labels 1, 1.1, and 2; AX body labels were stale and are not used as package evidence.

custom_xml.note: Word emitted the default bibliography data store, but this fixture does not claim a citation source record or bibliography field.

dotx.template_scope: Native template container and package content type are evidenced; template instantiation or execution semantics are not claimed.

container.file_identification: Composite Document File V2 Document, Little Endian, MacOS, code page 10000

read_example.equation_projection: The DOC reader exposes the converted inline equation as a QUOTE/object projection and does not expose the display equation's OMML semantics. Native Word visibly retained equation picture fallbacks: Picture2 inline and Picture1 for the summation.

textutil_read_only.observed: Extracted text retains the TOC field instructions/results, heading entries, numbered markers, PAGEREF instruction/result, and fixture markers; equation content is represented by legacy field/object controls rather than OMML text.

doc.conversion_scope: The DOC is a native Word 97-2003 derivative. Its equation picture/object fallbacks are valid legacy evidence but are not semantic parity with the DOCX OMML trees.

container.kind: Rich Text Format data, version 1, ANSI, code page 1252

read_example.error: MalformedDocument("RTF math zone contains an unsupported object destination")

textutil_read_only.observed: Extracted text retains TOC entries and cached page 1, all numbered and navigation markers, and the equation boundary markers; the equation text itself is blank in the text projection.

rtf.semantic_scope: Raw native RTF math, field, bookmark, list, and picture controls are recorded, but no semantic litchi-rtf parse claim is made because the reader rejects the native math object destination.

observations: DOCX and DOTX reopened with both native equation objects, the automatic Classic table of contents, cached TOC page references, hierarchical list labels 1, 1.1, and 2, and the bookmark/PAGEREF result visible.
DOC reopened without repair; Word displayed legacy equation picture fallbacks, including the inline equation and the summation, while retaining TOC and page-reference field content.
RTF reopened without repair; Word retained the equation objects, TOC, numbered list, bookmark, and page-reference content visible in the native UI.
native_ui_validation.semantic_scope: Native UI observations establish save/close/reopen acceptance and visible content for the listed scopes; they do not establish field refresh, pagination, rendering equivalence, or library support beyond the recorded package and reader probes.

known_limits: The DOCX and DOTX field results are cached native results; no field refresh, TOC regeneration, PAGEREF evaluation, or navigation behavior was performed by the library.
The DOC equation objects are legacy picture/object fallbacks and must not be counted as OMML semantic parity with the DOCX/DOTX files.

The native RTF contains math object destinations that litchi-rtf currently rejects with MalformedDocument("RTF math zone contains an unsupported object destination"); this is recorded as a reader boundary, not a corrupt-fixture diagnosis.
The default bibliography Custom XML store is present but empty; this fixture does not claim citation or bibliography-source coverage.
The numbering evidence covers one native multilevel decimal definition and three used paragraphs; it does not cover every numbering format or restart policy.
DOTX package/template storage is evidenced, but template instantiation and execution semantics are not verified.
